results.title: Three signs your design system is broken. | Tanya R.
results.content:
Three signs your design system is broken. You won't find them in metrics. You'll feel them in frustration. Signal 1: Every feature needs a new file. Designer opens Figma. Starts from scratch. Again. Nothing to reuse. Nothing to reference. Just... rebuild. That's not design. That's survival mode. Signal 2: Same bug. Different page. QA flags something familiar. Wait. Didn't we fix this? Yeah. On the other screen. Copy-paste culture creates copy-paste bugs. Signal 3: Design reviews feel like déjà vu. You've had this conversation before. Same spacing debate. Same button discussion. Same wasted hour. Nothing's documented. So everything gets relitigated. Each signal = velocity leak. Small on their own. Massive at scale. Your team isn't slow. Your system has holes. The fix? Which I did not, I have been looking for someone to contact or some proper support from Instagram (meta) there is none. I have been locked out of my account on my phone and have no method of getting it back. My account is inaccessible (potentially deleted/disabled but no notice/contact has been made) and there is no way for me to reach the business for further information. I believe that I have followed all of the platforms terms of service and community guidelines, and I am confident that there has been some mistake or misunderstanding that led to my account being disabled.
